legal_basis.from: City Council resolution repealing Ordinance 2026-03 and establishing a 365-day moratorium on accepting and processing applications for data centers and related development
legal_basis.to: City Council 'Data Center Ordinance Rescission and Moratorium Ordinance' (approved 2026-05-11, passed as amended, unanimous), rescinding Ordinance No. 2026-03 and adopting a temporary moratorium on accepting and processing data center applications; the staff draft's 90-day term was amended to 365 days on motion of Councilman Blount
legal_basis.reason: Approved minutes of the 2026-05-11 meeting show the item was an ordinance (not a resolution) and record the amendment from 90 to 365 days.

evidence.supports: Council adopted the rescission-and-moratorium item as amended to 365 days, unanimously, on 2026-05-11.
evidence.quote: Councilman Blount made a motion to amend the moratorium to 365 days. ... RESULT: PASSED AS AMENDED [UNANIMOUS]

evidence.supports: The 90-day text the tracker relies on is the unamended staff draft (suspension 'for a period of ninety (90) days').

decisions.notes: savrn is wrong: it read the 90-day staff draft (DocumentCenter 12289) and concluded the pause expired 2026-08-09. The 2026-05-11 minutes show council amended it to 365 days, so it runs to about 2027-05-11 and is active. Only change: legal_basis now names the instrument as the ordinance the minutes record, not a resolution.
